scope: read-only local-source and already completed confirmation raw analysis; no simulator, GPU, evaluation, FPS, training, or 830xx files accessed

braking_gate.failure_rule: A gate failure is reported as failure; do not relax any threshold, change Ki, or call this navigation/goal-completion success.

modeled_geometry.contact_shape: 14 individually rotating Y-axis cylinders; no continuous belt
modeled_geometry.terrain_contact_material: no explicit per-track/ground physics material in the local authored mesh; Newton default shape mu=.8 is configured

p_controller.actual_applied_effort_capture: NewtonManager.register_post_actuator_callback + Warp tape after actuator step on each internal Newton physics iteration
p_controller.conditional_antiwindup: block integration only when estimated P+I is outside +/-2 Nm and error pushes farther into saturation
p_controller.implementation: native per-wheel IdealPD only; Ki=0 keeps the two per-side integrators and broadcast feedforward exactly zero
p_controller.integral_feedforward_broadcast: one side value applied equally to each of that side's seven proxy wheels
p_controller.integral_state_basis: mean target-minus-actual angular velocity over seven proxy wheels per side
p_controller.ki_units_note: Nm per proxy wheel / (rad/s side-mean proxy wheel speed * s)
p_controller.name: capped_p_only_reference
p_controller.state_and_feedforward_reset: clear selected environment rows in _reset_idx wrapper

pi_controller.conditional_antiwindup: block integration only when estimated P+I is outside +/-2 Nm and error pushes farther into saturation
pi_controller.implementation: left/right mean-speed integral feedforward added through public target_command.set_effort_index after the original _apply_action; each side value is broadcast to its seven proxy wheels while native per-wheel IdealPD remains active
pi_controller.integral_feedforward_broadcast: one side value applied equally to each of that side's seven proxy wheels
pi_controller.integral_state_basis: mean target-minus-actual angular velocity over seven proxy wheels per side
pi_controller.ki_units_note: Nm per proxy wheel / (rad/s side-mean proxy wheel speed * s)
pi_controller.name: runtime_pi_counterfactual
pi_controller.state_and_feedforward_reset: clear selected environment rows in _reset_idx wrapper
